title: (BREAKING) Remove offline support from patient management
body:

See existing PR titles for inspiration.

- [x] My work includes tests or is validated by existing tests.

## Summary

Removes offline support from patient registration, patient search and patient list management ahead of [openmrs-esm-core#1894](https://github.com/openmrs/openmrs-esm-core/pull/1894).

Registration now always saves online. This removes queued registration and editing, queued-patient fallbacks, offline identifier restrictions and patient caching. Registration also stops fetching its metadata at app startup, which it did on every page load to precache it for offline use. The metadata requests used by online registration move from `offline.resources.ts` to `registration.resource.ts`. The registration and patient search entry points drop their `online` and `offline` route flags, so builds with offline support enabled treat them as online-only. It also removes unused save arguments and the unused initial address snapshot, and updates the existing tests.

This is a breaking change for deployments using offline registration. The compatible patient-management apps need to be deployed before adopting the framework version that removes the offline APIs.
